name: Michael Tremblay
title: Senior Database Administrator
summary: Senior Database Administrator with 12+ years of experience designing, securing, and optimizing enterprise database environments across high-availability production systems. Known for improving performance, strengthening backup and recovery strategies, and leading reliable database operations in regulated environments.

bullets: Administered a mixed SQL Server and Oracle estate supporting 180+ production and non-production databases with 99.98% availability.
Reduced average report query times by 42% through indexing, execution plan analysis, and schema tuning.
Led quarterly disaster recovery tests and cut critical recovery time objectives from 4 hours to 75 minutes.
Standardized backup, patching, and access-control procedures across 6 business units, improving audit readiness.
Managed day-to-day operations for 90+ SQL Server instances across primary data centers and DR sites.
Implemented Always On Availability Groups for core systems, eliminating single points of failure and improving service continuity.
Automated routine maintenance jobs and capacity monitoring, reducing after-hours incidents by 30%.
Partnered with developers to resolve blocking, locking, and indexing issues on high-volume transactional systems.
Supported patient-facing and internal applications in a HIPAA- and PHIPA-sensitive environment with strict access controls.
Improved backup success rates to 99.9% by redesigning maintenance plans and validating restore procedures monthly.
Assisted with version upgrades and migrations for 25+ databases, completing projects with no unplanned downtime.
Created documentation and runbooks for incident response, change management, and patch validation.
Provided first-line support for SQL Server databases and helped maintain uptime for client-facing applications.
Performed routine restores, user provisioning, and index maintenance under senior DBA supervision.
Tracked performance trends and identified recurring bottlenecks, contributing to measurable improvements in application responsiveness.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science

certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate
